verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships Neo, a built-in AI agent that it says 'provisions, governs, and optimizes your cloud infrastructure' and 'monitors outcomes automatically.' It is part of an all-in-one platform with 'AI built for infrastructure,' which implies in-product AI analysis of the user's infrastructure data. However, the evidence describes Neo mainly as an agent that executes changes, not one that surfaces insights or suggestions, and the MCP server exposes stack data to external assistants rather than inside the product. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated insights or recommendations drawn from the user's stacks, resources or costs; any description of how suggestions are presented in the Pulumi Cloud UI; independent or hands-on corroboration.
